arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS negative_amount_transactions FROM transactions WHERE amount_usd_cents < 0
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions whose amount is negative, across the whole table, whether or not they have a fraud label.
assumptions: Counted all transactions regardless of fraud label, since the question does not mention labels.
Covers the full data period 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
